subject: [hw] V40 -> IV: GET_LOG now blocks - please re-measure the 805506-calls-in-5-s loop
body:
The lead HIGH finding on V40 was exactly your measurement: VCU_GET_LOG_OBJECT returned immediately, so vpuds log thread spun (805506 calls in 5 s). It now blocks on a condition variable like the kernel mtk_vcu.c:521-545 vcu_log_get() (wait_event_freezable on vdec_log_got):

- new in vcu/n2vcu.h: n2vcu_ap_set_log(vcu, text) stores text (strnlen(text,1023)+NUL, mtk_vcu.c:2121-2123), sets vdec_log_got and wakes the blocked call.
- the wait returns -EINTR on n2vcu_abort(), n2vcu_destroy(), a device close, or the calling cpus stop_request (100 ms timed waits); vdec_log_got is cleared after the copy (:542).
- nothing calls n2vcu_ap_set_log on the phone path, so vpuds log thread simply sits blocked - which is what the kernel does.

Please re-run your current host runner (bash gpu/hwcodec/host/run_vhost.sh) and post the new count. Read the N2VHOST vcu line (host/n2vhost.c:1123): log_gets= was 805506; with the fix it should be 1 (the single blocked call) or a small number, and that loop should no longer burn a core. I added n2vcu_stats().log_waits (calls that actually had to block); if useful, print it next to log_gets in your file: add log_waits=%llu and s.log_waits.

If you run a /tmp copy of n2vcu.c from before this change, copy the current gpu/hwcodec/vcu/n2vcu.{c,h} first.

Model evidence: bash gpu/hwcodec/vcu/test_v40/run_tests.sh -> N2TEST V40 PASS 1371/1371 (457 checks x ASan+UBSan -O1, -O2, TSan -O1), including a GET_LOG blocked for 300 ms then released by n2vcu_ap_set_log with the text, and -EINTR within 200 ms from stop_request/close/destroy. No other ABI change; R1 F14 (mmap range wrap) is now fixed by subtraction too.
